conclusion: Validation and mutation are one atomic contract.
decision: Zero outputs on failure and reject upstream fake-success behavior.
invalidated_assumptions: A valid envelope does not imply a supported operation.
observation: Decoders validate version, identity, CRC, padding, and status before mutation; source-only DRM returns NOT_SUPPORTED.
question_or_symptom: Malformed or unsupported calls can mutate state or fake success.
